verdict.rationale: Column documents programmatically opening and managing FDIC-insured bank accounts, including FBO, sweep, clearing and custom types. It offers API-driven KYC/KYB verification as the application step. Its sandbox claims every route is sandboxed with production-like persistence, plus separate sandbox/live keys and simulated funding endpoints. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the end-to-end application-to-active lifecycle (KYC supports manual review, so fully automated activation is only implied), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the account-opening flow.
